en-US.description: Communication and Collaboration Apps for the Modern Workforce
en-US.longDescription: Bria is a leading business softphone solution by CounterPath that offers crystal-clear audio, desktop and mobile app availability, and works with various VoIP providers.
en-US.name: Bria
en-US.releaseNotes:
Updated API certificate for Bria Desktop API integration
The version 6.8.8.2 includes an updated API certificate used for Desktop API integration. This certificate will expire on May 17, 2027.
Bria for Windows and Mac 6.8.8.1 (September 28, 2026)
This patch release addresses an issue where the Bria client was mistakenly detected as suspicious software by some virus scanners.
Bria for Windows and Mac 6.8.8 (August 31, 2026)
STUN Server Decommission
The STUN server stun.counterpath.com has been decommissioned in September 2026. Check your email from CounterPath sent on August 7th for more details.
Resolved issues
This version contains improvements to the overall stability and performance of Bria and miscellaneous bug fixes.
- Includes a fix for a delay when using click-to-dial.
- Resolved the known issue on macOS 26 devices where the cursor disappears once the user starts typing in a field, such as the call field and the search contacts field.
Known issues in this version
Bria Version 6.8.8 has a known issue where call history does not display recording of a 3-way call if the user logs out during the call.
- Even though call history does not display recording, recording is saved locally. To access the recording file, open Bria, go to Preferences > Advanced > Recording folder and click Open Folder.
- To prevent an accidental logout during a call, the app now displays a confirmation dialog to the user.

Known issues
Video call issues
If the remote party tries to add video to an audio call on your Team Voice account, the call is dropped. If the caller tries to add video to an audio call, the call remains as an audio call. In order to use video, place the call as a video call.
